high_level_description: This image captures a scene inside an Apple store, likely during a product launch or promotional event. The setting is modern and sleek, with a white ceiling adorned with circular light fixtures that create a futuristic ambiance. In the foreground, two iPhones are prominently displayed on stands. The phone on the left is a gold-colored iPhone 13 Pro Max, identifiable by its triple-lens camera setup on the back. The phone on the right is a black iPhone 12 Pro Max, showcasing a vibrant display screen with a colorful wallpaper featuring abstract shapes in shades of red, orange, and pink.
